description: SHAPE: `{matches: [{canonical_code, name_cn, ticker, exchange}], count}` — the row container is `matches`, not `items`, and the name field is `name_cn`. Resolve a Chinese name / A-share code / pinyin initials to canonical codes (e.g. SSE:600519). Use this first whenever the agent has a description but needs a canonical_code for downstream calls. AH dual-listing: when a company is listed on both A-share and HK (e.g. 工商银行 SSE:601398 / HK:01398), prefer the A-share canonical for all downstream analysis unless the user explicitly asks for the HK side.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

text.description: Search text: Chinese name (贵州茅台), code (600519), or pinyin (gzmt)

name: lookup
